verified_storage_properties: Legacy v1 initialization and exact serialization remain the default; open never performs migration.
Migration holds the existing owner lock, verifies v1 state/archive invariants, retains byte-identical legacy-v1.json and refuses any partial preparation.
Cancellation remains effective through temporary-head fsync immediately before activation rename; ambiguous activation never triggers automatic rollback.
V2 mutable State contains no retained archive payload. Successful append moves only the validated suffix into the single resident Vec after chunk and head durability.

Committed hash-linked full-block chunks enforce exact counts, first/tail metadata, pool/version, slot/parent joins, raw checksums and EOF. Missing, substituted, corrupt or symlinked committed paths fail closed.

The complete original archive prefix is independently bound to the retained legacy file by a streamed canonical complete-block hash chain; rechecksummed omission or transaction-byte substitution fails.
Persistence failures poison further writes; reopen follows only the committed head and never adopts, overwrites or removes orphan tails.
Existing job, checkpoint, exact unknown signed-attempt, transport, proof-failure and alert data remain preserved by migration fixtures.
historical_observations: Initial local no-run compile stopped because the new test module had not yet been created; its log is retained under the private candidate evidence directory.
Earlier candidate test runs predate the final cancellation, complete-prefix and buffered-hashing review corrections; their logs and source inventories remain retained.
limits: The full historical archive still resides in memory once and continues growing on disk. This does not qualify long-term use on 4GiB or establish any hosting SLO.
Migration temporarily requires the original primary, retained exact backup and complete chunks; the backup is not pruned.
Cold open rereads the retained source and all committed chunks; the legacy-prefix visitor holds one block at a time and no second full archive Vec.
The existing local owner.lock is not distributed fencing, cross-machine clone detection or filesystem rollback protection.
Host transfer, installation, stopped-state anchors, guarded live migration, cold-open and live catch-up are separate outcomes.
